d: In this episode of Honesty Box, we're joined by Gypsy Traveller Charlotte-Ann Maguire as she answers your burning questions about her culture and way of life including dating, discrimination and the impact of ‘Big Fat Gypsy Weddings'.

Former prison governor Vanessa Frake provides answers to anonymous questions regarding the British prison system, sharing revealing insights about notorious serial killers, and delving into the question of what constitutes true evil.

Big Phil Campion, a former SAS Soldier who also spent time working on the circuit as a private mercenary, answers your questions on how many people he's killed and what three things he'd rely on in a survival situation.

Below Deck's Captain Sandy Yawn answers your questions on her experiences as a Superyacht captain. The TV personality shares stories of her times travelling through the Bermuda Triangle and what the scariest things you can see in the ocean are.

Jon Atack, a former Scientology member turned authoritarian cult expert and author, provides invaluable insights from his personal experiences, shedding light on the hierarchy, leadership, celebrity involvement, and origin story of the organisation.

Manchester United fan Culture Cams tells Chelsea fan Joey Knight why he thinks Erik Ten Hag is a better manager than Mauricio Pochettino. The two argue over some of the biggest debates between the two Premier League clubs.

Liverpool fan Laurence McKenna and Arsenal fan Cecil Jee Thomas argue over the biggest talking points of the 2023/24 season, clashing over who'll win a trophy next and whether Gabriel and Saliba would make it into a combined team over van Dijk.
Lee Judges and Lewis Bowden clash in Agree To Disagree, debating Arsenal's title hopes, Newcastle's rise and Premier League pressure with bold opinions and heated football banter.

Eddie Hearn and Frank Warren debate some of boxing's biggest debates. The two promoters discuss Anthony Joshua vs Tyson Fury? Which Premier League player would make the best boxer? As well as debates about Jake Paul and MrBeast.

Manchester United legends Paul Scholes and Nicky Butt take on Agree to Disagree, debating Michael Carrick, Bruno Fernandes, United's title hopes and football's greatest players with honest opinions and plenty of banter.

Ahead of Tottenham Hotspur against Liverpool, ‪Expressions‬ tells Laurence McKenna why he thinks Mo Salah is overrated and why he thinks Arne Slot will be sacked before Thomas Frank. The two argue over some of the biggest debates between the teams.

Man City legend Micah Richards and former Liverpool and Spurs player Jamie Redknapp debate some of the Premier League and England's biggest football debates, such as who is England's Greatest Ever Player: Rooney, Kane, or Beckham?

Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Emily Blunt, Stanley Tucci and Simone Ashley reunite for Agree To Disagree, debating fashion, food and travel with sharp wit, big opinions and plenty of Runway-worthy chaos.

Man United Fan KG tells Spurs Abbi Summers why he thinks Tottenham is not a Big Six Club. No love lost between the pair as the two argue over some of the biggest debates between the two Premier League sides.

Ryder Cup legends Ian Poulter and Tyrrell Hatton take on a game of Agree To Disagree. The golfers tackle some of sport's biggest debates, such as: Are American golf fans worse than European golf fans? And, is a hole-in-one harder than a 147 break?

Liverpool fan Paul Machin tells Manchester United fan Flex that Steven Gerrard was a much better player than Paul Scholes was. The pair debate the biggest arguments between the two most successful clubs in England.

We sit down with Master Shi Heng Yi of the Shaolin Temple Europe to uncover the reality of the warrior's path. Discussing the internal power of Chan Buddhism, he reveals how ancient virtues can serve as cures for modern anxiety and stress.

In this episode of Minutes With, we speak to Jacob Dunne, who accidentally killed a man with one punch on a night out. Jacob tells us how this event changed his life, how it feels to speak to the parents of the victim and how he's moving forward.

In this week's episode of Minutes With, prison governor Vanessa Frake reveals what it's like inside the UK's most dangerous prisons. She opens up about meeting notorious serial murderers Rose West and Myra Hindley, along with the creative ways prisoners smuggle contraband like drugs and weapons into jails.

Chris Fuller, a former British Army Bomb Disposal Officer, who now does humanitarian work in the Middle East, talks to us about defusing bombs in the centre of London, and the difference between working in the UK and abroad.
